intro: Cyrus Therepentous is a formidable black dragonspawn residing in the cavernous depths of Slither Rock in the Burning Steppes. Rather than immediately striking down intruders, he tests daring mortals to see if they possess the strength to serve the purposes of the Black dragonflight.

p: Secluded inside a cavern at Slither Rock, Cyrus Therepentous oversees the volcanic crags of the Burning Steppes. Like many of his kind, he views mortal travelers with immense condescension, declaring that only fools would disturb his lair. Yet beneath his ferocious exterior lies a cold calculation: rather than consuming every trespasser on sight, he offers them a lethal challenge against his minions, willing to exploit those resilient enough to survive the trials of flame.
